meta.title: A vendor cannot send a bulk counter offer
gaps: the plan has the vendor send POST /additional_request/raise_bulk_counter_offer, but the supplier app may not call POST /additional_request/raise_bulk_counter_offer (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event where the invited QA vendor bid, and the bidding window is over.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the additional request raise bulk counter offer request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
